# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools` from the server's own tool definitions; do not edit by hand. -->

rydspine provides 49 MCP tools. Coordinates are world space unless a tool says otherwise: y points up, units are pixels, rotations are degrees counter-clockwise. Animation values are offsets from the setup pose (`scalex`/`scaley` are multipliers). See the workflow in [README.md](README.md#workflow).

## project_create

Create a new empty project (root bone only).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **Required.** |

## project_import

Import an existing Spine 4.3 export as a new project so it can be inspected and edited: the skeleton JSON plus either the folder of source images or the .atlas file (its PNG pages are unpacked).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **Required.** New project name |
| `skeleton` | string | **Required.** Path to the exported skeleton .json |
| `images` | string | Folder of source PNGs (Spine's images folder) |
| `atlas` | string | Path to the .atlas, used when there is no images folder |
| `loops` | string[] | Animations that should loop seamlessly |

## project_list

List projects.

No parameters.

## project_status

Show the rig as text: bone tree, slots, constraints, animations, images.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |

## image_import

Import PNG parts. Each becomes a slot with the same name showing the image centered at world (x, y). Import back-to-front: later images draw on top.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `images` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `images[].path` | string | **Required.** Path to a PNG file |
| `images[].name` | string | Slot/image name (default: file name) |
| `images[].x` | number |  |
| `images[].y` | number |  |
| `images[].bone` | string | Bone to attach to (default root) |

## psd_import

Import every visible pixel layer of a PSD as a part (image + slot), keeping position, layer order, opacity and blend mode. World origin defaults to the bottom-center of the canvas (where feet stand). Pivot markers: a layer "<name>[pivot]" (a small dot; may be hidden) is not imported but adds a bone at its center for the layer or group <name> beside it; a bare "[pivot]" inside a group pivots the group. Bones nest like the groups (a part's bone is a child of its group's bone), and parts attach to the nearest bone.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `psd` | string | **Required.** Path to the .psd file |
| `origin` | `"bottom-center"` \| `"center"` \| `"top-left"` |  |
| `includeHidden` | boolean | Also import hidden layers (with nothing shown) |
| `keepGroups` | boolean | Name images group/layer instead of layer |

## image_view

Return an imported image so you can look at it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `image` | string | **Required.** |

## image_inspect

Look at a flat picture before image_split: returns it with a labeled grid in image pixels (x right, y down from the top-left), plus its size, detected background and the separate blobs with their boxes.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `image` | string | **Required.** Path to a PNG |
| `step` | integer | Grid spacing in image pixels (default about a tenth of the size) (≥ 5) |
| `background` | string | "auto" (default: transparent if the border is, else the most common border color), "transparent", or "#rrggbb" |
| `tolerance` | number | Per-channel difference still counted as background color (default 24) (≥ 0, ≤ 255) |

## image_split

Split a flat picture (one PNG, no layers) into parts and import them like psd_import (one image + slot each, at its place, origin bottom-center by default). Without `parts`, every separate blob on the background becomes a part (part-1 is the largest). With `parts`, outline each part with a polygon in image pixels (read them off image_inspect), listed back to front: where outlines overlap the later part owns the pixels, so trace a part tightly where it lies over another (loosely is fine against the background, which is cut away), and stray pixels near an outline join it. overlap=N paints in up to N pixels of what the parts in front hide (smearing the part's own edge colors, only inside its outline: outline the whole part, hidden piece included), so joints do not open gaps when parts turn; use about the joint's thickness/4 on parts behind a joint. On a plain-color background the anti-aliased rim is unmixed from it (matte, default 2 px) so no halo of the background shows on other backdrops. Returns an overlay (each part tinted, unassigned pixels magenta); dryRun=true only returns it.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `image` | string | **Required.** Path to the flat PNG |
| `parts` | object[] | Parts back to front; omit to split into separate blobs |
| `parts[].name` | string | **Required.** |
| `parts[].polygon` | [number, number][] | **Required.** Outline [[x, y], ...] in image pixels, y down |
| `parts[].overlap` | number | (≥ 0, ≤ 256) |
| `background` | string | "auto" (default: transparent if the border is, else the most common border color), "transparent", or "#rrggbb" |
| `tolerance` | number | Per-channel difference still counted as background color (default 24) (≥ 0, ≤ 255) |
| `matte` | integer | Plain-color background: rim width unmixed from it (default 2, 0 = off) (≥ 0, ≤ 8) |
| `overlap` | number | Default overlap for every part (default 0) (≥ 0, ≤ 256) |
| `minArea` | integer | Blob mode: smaller blobs join the nearest part (default 64) (≥ 1) |
| `snap` | integer | Outline mode: stray pixels this close join a part (default 4) (≥ 0, ≤ 64) |
| `prefix` | string | Blob mode: names are <prefix>-1, <prefix>-2, ... (default part) |
| `origin` | `"bottom-center"` \| `"center"` \| `"top-left"` |  |
| `dryRun` | boolean | Only show the split; import nothing |

## bone_add

Add bones, in order (parents first). With space=world, x/y/rotation are world values (e.g. joint positions on the art).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `bones` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `bones[].name` | string | **Required.** |
| `bones[].parent` | string | Parent bone (default root) |
| `bones[].x` | number |  |
| `bones[].y` | number |  |
| `bones[].rotation` | number |  |
| `bones[].length` | number |  |
| `bones[].scaleX` | number |  |
| `bones[].scaleY` | number |  |
| `bones[].color` | string | RRGGBBAA |
| `bones[].space` | `"local"` \| `"world"` | Coordinate space for x/y/rotation (default local) |

## bone_update

Move, reparent (keeps world position), rename or resize a bone. compensate=true keeps its child bones and its slots' regions and unweighted meshes where they are, e.g. to aim a bone placed by a [pivot] marker.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `name` | string | **Required.** |
| `rename` | string |  |
| `parent` | string | Parent bone (default root) |
| `x` | number |  |
| `y` | number |  |
| `rotation` | number |  |
| `length` | number |  |
| `scaleX` | number |  |
| `scaleY` | number |  |
| `color` | string | RRGGBBAA |
| `space` | `"local"` \| `"world"` | Coordinate space for x/y/rotation (default local) |
| `compensate` | boolean | Keep children and attachments in place in the world |

## bone_remove

Remove an unused bone.

|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `name` | string | **Required.** |

## rig_template

| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `template` | object | **Required.** |
| `template.kind` | `"chain"` | *When kind = "chain".* **Required.** |

## slot_update

Bind a slot to a bone (keepWorld keeps the art where it is, default true), change the visible attachment, color, blend mode, or draw order (0 = back).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `name` | string | **Required.** |
| `bone` | string |  |
| `keepWorld` | boolean |  |
| `attachment` | string \| null |  |
| `color` | string |  |
| `blend` | `"normal"` \| `"additive"` \| `"multiply"` \| `"screen"` |  |
| `drawOrder` | integer |  |

## sequence_import

Import PNG frames as one image sequence attachment (flipbook: flames, sparkles, blinking lights, hand-drawn effects), centered at world (x, y). Makes a new slot on top, or adds the attachment to slot. Play it with anim_sequence_keys.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `name` | string | **Required.** Attachment name (and the new slot's name) |
| `images` | string[] | **Required.** PNG files, in playing order |
| `slot` | string | Existing slot to add the attachment to |
| `x` | number |  |
| `y` | number |  |
| `bone` | string | Bone for a new slot (default root) |
| `setup` | integer | Frame shown in the setup pose (default 0) (≥ 0) |

## shape_add

Add a point (a marker the game reads: muzzle, hand grip, spawn spot), a bounding box (hit area) or a clipping mask, each in a new slot. Shapes are world points, or around=<slot> traces that slot's image outline or mesh hull. A clipping masks the slots from `from` (default end) up to `end` and is placed right below `from`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `type` | `"point"` \| `"boundingbox"` \| `"clipping"` | **Required.** |
| `name` | string | **Required.** attachment and new slot name |
| `bone` | string | bone the slot follows (default: the bone of around, else root) |
| `x` | number | point: world x (default the bone's origin) |
| `y` | number |  |
| `rotation` | number | point: world rotation in degrees |
| `points` | object[] | boundingbox/clipping: world polygon |
| `points[].x` | number | **Required.** |
| `points[].y` | number | **Required.** |
| `around` | string | boundingbox/clipping: trace this slot's art instead of points |
| `padding` | number | around: grow the outline by px (default 2) (≥ 0, ≤ 32) |
| `from` | string | clipping: first slot masked |
| `end` | string | clipping: last slot masked (required) |

## mirror_bones

Copy one side of a rig to the other side of a vertical mirror line: the given bones and everything below them, their slots and attachments (same images, flipped), and their IK and physics constraints. Names swap side (left-arm -> right-arm, armL -> armR, eye_l -> eye_r). Then mirror_animation copies motion across.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `bones` | string[] | **Required.** Top bones of the side to copy (their children come along) |
| `axis` | number | World x of the mirror line (default: the root bone's x) |
| `sides` | [string, string] | Side words when not left/right or l/r, e.g. ["front", "back"] |

## mirror_animation

Make the other side's version of an animation. mode=swap (default): left and right timelines trade places with their values (side views: the walk led by the other leg). mode=mirror: the motion is reflected across a vertical line (front views: wave with the other hand, lean the other way); needs a symmetric rig such as one made with mirror_bones. Slots, constraints, draw order and events swap too.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `to` | string | New animation name (default <animation>-mirrored); the same name changes it in place |
| `mode` | `"swap"` \| `"mirror"` |  |
| `sides` | [string, string] | Side words when not left/right or l/r |

## mesh_generate

Turn a region attachment into a mesh so it can bend, or rebuild an existing mesh (new outline or weights; refused if it has deform keys). shape=contour (default) follows the image's opaque outline; shape=grid covers the whole rectangle. Give bones to weight it automatically by distance (bind the slot and place bones first); smooth blends weights between neighboring bones so a sheet bends without tearing.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `slot` | string | **Required.** |
| `attachment` | string |  |
| `shape` | `"contour"` \| `"grid"` |  |
| `detail` | number | contour: max outline error in px (smaller = more hull vertices) (> 0) |
| `spacing` | number | contour: interior vertex spacing in px (> 0) |
| `padding` | number | contour: grow outline by px (default 2) (≥ 0, ≤ 16) |
| `cols` | integer | grid columns (default 4) (≥ 1, ≤ 32) |
| `rows` | integer | grid rows (default 4) (≥ 1, ≤ 32) |
| `bones` | string[] |  |
| `maxInfluences` | integer | (≥ 1, ≤ 4) |
| `smooth` | number | px over which weights blend between bones (default 0: nearest bone wins); ~the bone spacing for paper, cloth, ribbons (≥ 0, ≤ 2000) |

## constraint_add

Add an IK, transform, path, physics or slider constraint.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|

## anim_set_keys

Set explicit keys on one bone property. Replaces existing keys between the first and last given time (or `range`), keeping the rest. ease applies to the segment after each key.

| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `bone` | string | **Required.** |
| `property` | `"rotate"` \| `"translatex"` \| `"translatey"` \| `"scalex"` \| `"scaley"` \| `"scale"` \| `"shearx"` \| `"sheary"` | **Required.** |

| `keys[].time` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0) |
| `keys[].value` | number | **Required.** |
| `keys[].ease` | `"linear"` \| `"stepped"` \| `"ease-in"` \| `"ease-out"` \| `"ease-in-out"` \| `"back-in"` \| `"back-out"` \| [number, number, number, number] | Curve of the segment after the key: a preset, or a CSS cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2] (y may overshoot 0..1) |
| `range` | [number, number] |  |

## anim_oscillate

Smooth back-and-forth motion (flap, sway, breathe, bob, wag). Use delayPerBone on a chain for follow-through (tails, necks, branches). In loop animations the period is fitted to whole cycles.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `property` | `"rotate"` \| `"translatex"` \| `"translatey"` \| `"scalex"` \| `"scaley"` \| `"scale"` \| `"shearx"` \| `"sheary"` | **Required.** |
| `amplitude` | number | **Required.** |
| `period` | number | **Required.** Seconds per cycle (> 0) |
| `start` | number | (≥ 0) |
| `end` | number | Default: animation length, or one period |
| `phase` | number | Starting phase in cycles (0..1) |
| `center` | number |  |
| `bones` | string[] | **Required.** Bones to animate; for a chain, list root to tip |
| `delayPerBone` | number | Seconds each bone lags the previous one (follow-through) |
| `falloff` | number | Amplitude multiplier per bone down the chain, e.g. 1.2 grows toward the tip |

## anim_constraint_keys

Key a constraint over time. ik mix: mix (or value), softness, bendPositive, compress, stretch. transform mix: mixRotate, mixX, mixY, mixScaleX, mixScaleY, mixShearY. path: position or spacing (value), mix (mixRotate, mixX, mixY); animate position to slide bones along the path or roll treads. physics: inertia, strength, damping, mass, wind, gravity, mix (value) or reset (time only; constraint "" = all physics). slider: time (value, seconds into its animation) or mix. Channels a key leaves out keep the setup value. Replaces keys between the first and last given time.

## anim_draw_order_keys

Change which slots draw in front during an animation (an arm swinging behind the body, a card turning over). Each key's order lists slot names back to front: all slots, or just the ones that move, which then trade the places they hold in setup (e.g. [body, arm] puts arm in front of body). No order: back to setup. Draw order holds until the next key. Replaces keys between the first and last given time.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `keys` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `keys[].time` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0) |
| `keys[].order` | string[] |  |

## anim_sequence_keys

Play an image sequence attachment (see sequence_import): from each key on, mode (hold, once, loop, pingpong, onceReverse, loopReverse, pingpongReverse; default hold), starting frame index (0-based) and delay (seconds per frame, e.g. 1/12). Replaces keys between the first and last given time.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `slot` | string | **Required.** |
| `attachment` | string | Default: the slot's setup attachment |
| `skin` | string |  |
| `keys` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `keys[].time` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0) |
| `keys[].mode` | `"hold"` \| `"once"` \| `"loop"` \| `"pingpong"` \| `"onceReverse"` \| `"loopReverse"` \| `"pingpongReverse"` |  |
| `keys[].index` | integer | (≥ 0) |
| `keys[].delay` | number | (≥ 0) |

## anim_deform_keys

Reshape a mesh over time (deform keys): stretch a glow into a streak, bulge a flag, squash a blob, bend a tip. Each key lists moves in world space applied in order to the setup shape (no moves = setup shape): scaleX along `angle` and scaleY across it, rotate, then x/y, around `pivot` (default: the mesh's center). `radius` limits a move to vertices near the pivot, fading out smoothly. Make the mesh first (mesh_generate); a mesh with deform keys cannot be rebuilt. Replaces keys between the first and last given time.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `slot` | string | **Required.** |
| `attachment` | string | Default: the slot's setup attachment |
| `skin` | string |  |
| `keys` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `keys[].time` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0) |
| `keys[].moves` | object[] |  |
| `keys[].moves[].pivot` | object |  |
| `keys[].moves[].pivot.x` | number | **Required.** |
| `keys[].moves[].pivot.y` | number | **Required.** |
| `keys[].moves[].scaleX` | number |  |
| `keys[].moves[].scaleY` | number |  |
| `keys[].moves[].angle` | number | Direction of scaleX, degrees (default 0) |
| `keys[].moves[].rotate` | number |  |
| `keys[].moves[].x` | number |  |
| `keys[].moves[].y` | number |  |
| `keys[].moves[].radius` | number | (> 0) |
| `keys[].ease` | `"linear"` \| `"stepped"` \| `"ease-in"` \| `"ease-out"` \| `"ease-in-out"` \| `"back-in"` \| `"back-out"` \| [number, number, number, number] | Curve of the segment after the key: a preset, or a CSS cubic-bezier [x1, y1, x2, y2] (y may overshoot 0..1) |

## anim_gait

Walk or run cycle in place for IK feet (e.g. biped left-leg-target phase 0, right-leg-target phase 0.5). Planted feet slide back at constant speed; reports the ground speed to move the character at and when each foot lands (event keys a footstep event there, string = foot bone). Walk: contact ~0.6, run: ~0.35 with more lift and bob.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `feet` | object[] | **Required.** |
| `feet[].bone` | string | **Required.** |
| `feet[].phase` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0, ≤ 1) |
| `body` | string | Bone that bobs, e.g. hips |
| `period` | number | **Required.** (> 0) |
| `stride` | number | **Required.** (> 0) |
| `lift` | number | **Required.** (≥ 0) |
| `contact` | number | (≥ 0.1, ≤ 0.9) |
| `bob` | number | (≥ 0) |
| `start` | number | (≥ 0) |
| `cycles` | integer | (≥ 1, ≤ 20) |
| `event` | string | Event fired as each foot lands, e.g. footstep |

## motion_check

Check feet for sliding: while a foot bone is on the ground its horizontal speed must stay constant (0 when standing still, the ground speed in an in-place cycle).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | **Required.** Project name |
| `animation` | string | **Required.** |
| `feet` | string[] | **Required.** Bones whose origin is the foot contact point (IK targets) |
| `tolerance` | number | Height above ground still counted as contact (px, default 1) (≥ 0) |
| `maxSlip` | number | Allowed speed change while planted, px/frame (default 0.5) (≥ 0) |
